(1) the use of syntactic information in information extraction is a promising research area; (2) the use of semantic information is a necessary condition for a successful application; (3) the application of information extraction techniques to the problem of opinion classification is feasible and can be successfully applied.

In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a web application that extracts opinions expressed in web pages and classifies them according to the subject and the opinion itself.
the development of an information extraction system which automatically extracts information from unstructured text, and then applies data mining techniques to the extracted information.
the application of information extraction techniques to opinion classification.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

information extraction techniques, in conjunction with data mining, can be used to extract structured data from unstructured texts and, therefore, can be used as an enabling technology for data mining applications.

the information extraction approach is more effective and efficient in the case of the classification of the opinions, while the text mining approach is more effective in the case of sentiment analysis.
information extraction is a technology that can be applied successfully in data mining applications.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed an application of information retrieval techniques to data mining.
we propose an approach for information extraction which is based on a hybrid of rule-based and machine learning techniques.
we have developed a prototype for the extraction of opinions about products or companies from the Web, which has a very good performance and can be easily integrated in a data warehouse.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, by using the right tools, information extraction can be used as a data mining technique, with a significant impact in terms of accuracy.
information extraction can be successfully applied in data mining, and that it can produce better results than traditional text mining techniques.
information extraction can be applied successfully to the problem of opinion mining.
